 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains **why people might yawn due to lack of oxygen and then restates the idea in different words.**
 
• The appropriate word should connect the restatement of the previous idea.
 
• "**Other**" fits well as it introduces an alternative way of expressing the same thought.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is** 'other.'**
 
• Hence, the correct statement from the passage should read **"****In other __words....."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("some", "new", "rather") do not fit as naturally in this context as "other" does to indicate a restatement.

 
• **Some** (कुछ): "Some" introduces a non-specific quantity, which does not apply to rephrasing the previous statement about yawning.
 
• **New (**नया): "New" introduces something entirely different, which does not align with the idea of restating the reason for yawning.
 
• **Rather** (बल्कि): "Rather" introduces a preference or alternative, which does not fit the context of explaining the same idea differently.
